documents.confirmationCheck: Does the new sample lie flatter while both sides still form a balanced, secure stitch? If not, stop this path and seek another cause.
documents.riskNotes: This is a test-sample experiment, not authorization to alter, unpick or restitch the finished garment.
documents.safeAction: On another scrap seam only, try a modestly lower upper-thread tension while maintaining a balanced stitch. Change one setting at a time and compare it with the original sample.
documents.title: Compare a lower-tension sample

documents.howToCheck: Use scrap material only. Sew a short sample with the same machine, thread and settings. Carefully release both threads along a small section without pulling or damaging the fabric; compare the released and still-stitched sections.
documents.makerQuestion: On a short, sacrificial seam made from matching scrap fabric, do the ripples flatten when you carefully remove a few centimetres of stitches?
documents.riskNotes: Do not remove stitches from the actual garment for this preliminary test; stop if the sample fabric is being damaged.
documents.title: Does a test seam relax when the stitches are released?
